name: Trios
label: Trio No.
title: Trios
description: Three colours, each a finish: one hero colour drenched over the walls and built-in joinery, one for the upholstery, and one soft neutral to breathe. Each trio has its own card, made to be screenshotted and handed to the image maker, and to sit beside the finished room.
data: Made in the studio; colours and names chosen by the studio
note: House style for every trio: dark wood floors, brass lighting, classic panelling or arched built-ins, one centred focal wall, warm lamplight.
house: dark wood floors, brass lighting (wall sconces, a picture light or a chandelier), classic panelling or arched built-ins with softly lit shelves, one centred focal wall
